compliance.planDisallowedTopicBlock: Remove protected or disallowed topics from your questions and evaluation criteria.
compliance.classifierDisallowedTopicBlock: Remove a protected or disallowed topic from your interview ({{category}}): {{reason}}
compliance.questionWarning: This question references a protected or disallowed topic and can't be published. Rephrase it to stay job-related.
compliance.criterionWarning: This criterion references a protected or disallowed topic and can't be published. Keep it job-related.
compliance.overrideTitle: An automated compliance check flagged this
compliance.overrideFlagSummary: An automated check flagged a question or criterion as possibly relating to a protected topic ({{category}}): {{reason}}
compliance.overrideWarning: If you publish anyway, you confirm this content is job-related and non-discriminatory. You — not HireCall's automated check — are responsible for that decision, and this override is recorded with your identity.
compliance.overrideJustificationPlaceholder: e.g. Weekend availability is an essential scheduling requirement for this shift-based role.
compliance.overrideJustificationHint: Write at least {{count}} words. This justification is stored on the published role screen for audit.
compliance.classifierUnavailable: The automated compliance check couldn't run, so publishing is paused. Please try again in a moment.
compliance.overrideRequiresAdmin: Only a workspace owner or admin can override a compliance flag. Ask an admin to review and publish.
compliance.overrideRateLimited: You've reached the override limit for now — further overrides need a workspace admin to review.

roleManagement.forbidden: Only workspace owners, admins, and recruiters can manage roles.
roleManagement.publishedRoleLimitReached: Your workspace has reached its published role limit. Manage billing to publish another role.
roleManagement.billingUnavailable: Billing is unavailable for this workspace. Retry or ask the workspace owner to manage billing.

source.title: How do you want to add this role?
source.description: Start from a role brief you already have, or enter the details yourself. You will review everything before HireCall drafts questions.
source.manualDescription: Enter the title, context, and responsibilities yourself.
source.uploadDescription: Extract a PDF or DOCX privately, then review every field.
source.urlDescription: Import a LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Teamtailor, or public career page link.
source.urlSupportedSources: Works with LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Teamtailor, and most public career pages
source.unavailableDescription: Public URL and PDF/DOCX import will be available when private role intake is configured.

upload.title: Upload a role brief
upload.description: Add a text-based PDF or DOCX. HireCall checks it privately and asks you to confirm the extracted details before creating anything.
upload.dragHint: Drag and drop, or click to browse
upload.requirements: One text-based document, up to 10 MB

errors.too_large: Choose a document smaller than 10 MB, or start manually.
errors.unsupported: HireCall accepts PDF and DOCX role briefs only.
errors.uploadFailed: The private upload did not finish. Choose the document again.

url.title: Import a job link
url.description: Paste a LinkedIn, Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Teamtailor, or public career page link. HireCall prepares an editable draft and asks you to confirm every field.
url.label: Public job URL
url.hint: Use the public HTTPS link of the exact job. Indeed and Welcome to the Jungle forbid automated reads: upload the file or enter the role instead.

errors.required: Enter a public HTTPS job URL.

progress.processing: Checking and reading the role details
progress.autoUpdate: You can keep this page open. It updates automatically when the review is ready.

privacy.pending_deletion: The source stays private and is deleted after extraction or within 24 hours.
privacy.deleted: The source file has been deleted. Its contents are no longer retained.
privacy.not_stored: HireCall does not retain or render the public page. Only the reviewed role details continue.

manual.title: This document has no readable text
manual.description: Scanned and image-only documents are not guessed. Enter the role manually or choose a text-based file.

replace.title: This document cannot be imported safely
replace.description: No role was created. Choose another PDF or DOCX, or enter the role manually.

resume.title: This brief is already in HireCall
resume.description: Resume the existing private import instead of creating a duplicate role.

retry.title: The import could not finish
retry.description: No role was created. Try the source again or continue manually.

unreachable.title: This job posting could not be read
unreachable.description: The site blocks automated reads and the posting is not in the public index. No role was created — paste a different link or enter the role manually.

review.title: Check the role brief
review.fileDescription: HireCall extracted the document without inventing missing fields. Confirm the details before questions are drafted.
review.urlDescription: HireCall prepared an editable draft from the public source. Confirm the details before questions are drafted.
review.validationSummary: Add the required role title and job description before continuing.
review.jobDescriptionPlaceholder: Describe the responsibilities, expected outcomes, team context, and requirements.
review.descriptionHint: Keep only job-related information that should shape interview questions.
review.confirmation: Only the fields you approve continue to the question builder.

warnings.indexed_source_review_required: This draft comes from an indexed public source. Confirm every field against the linked job page before continuing.
warnings.extraction_truncated: The document was unusually long. Review the end of the description because the extracted text was shortened.
warnings.docx_parser_notice: Part of the DOCX formatting could not be preserved. Review the extracted text before continuing.
